queries.request: I asked a yes or no question and got three paragraphs. Answer what I actually asked.
The actual answer was hidden at the bottom. Check how well your recent replies communicate.
That response was vague and went off on a tangent. Stay on topic.
Did you leave out anything I'd need, or pad it with things I didn't ask about? Review your last few messages.
Be upfront about what you couldn't verify in that report; it reads as if everything is certain.
Evaluate whether your summary is clear, relevant and complete.
Your explanation skipped the part about rollback and added a lot of unrelated trivia. Fix the balance.
Reset how you communicate with me: relevant, clear, honest about limits.
I asked one thing and you replied to another.
Is this write-up too thin or too long for what was needed? Audit it.
Make this paragraph shorter without losing any numbers.
Rewrite the PR description so the bottom line comes first.
I can't parse this decision memo; break it into one decision at a time.
Explain what a mutex is in plain words.
Trim the verbosity from your last reply.
Shorten this ticket so a product owner can scan it.
Help me digest this dense message you just sent.
ELI5 what this stack trace means.
